instruction_summary: Analysis-only follow-up: from 001-living-update's artifacts, characterize how the Geometry-of-Truth linear structure (probe accuracy, cross-dataset generalization, best-layer relative depth) varies with scale, family, generation, and base->instruct tuning; fit a simple scale relation and restate the paper's claim in updated words.

steps.description: Read 001 artifacts (generalization_followup.json, flip_rates.json) and on-disk model configs (num_hidden_layers; safetensors total_size/2 for params). Confirmed baselines: Llama-2-13B C3 MM 0.9746, 7B<13B C19 gap (0.519 vs 0.769).
steps.command: python3 inspect of 001/results/*.json and model config.json/safetensors.index.json

steps.description: Built a fresh CPU venv (numpy/scipy/matplotlib/pandas/torch) in the 002 workspace (the 001 venv lacks scipy and is read-only history).
steps.command: uv venv .venv && uv pip install numpy scipy matplotlib pandas 'torch==2.*'

steps.description: Ran all six analyses: (1) C19/C3 vs log10(params) log-linear + saturating-exp fits; (2) best-val layer relative depth per model/family; (3) MM negation gaps from the stored generalization matrices; (4) generation/family group means; (5) base-vs-instruct accuracy deltas + cosine similarity of MM directions computed on CPU from 001 activations (reusing probes.MMProbe verbatim); (6) synthesized fitted relation.
Built the three required figures (accuracy-vs-scale with fits; best relative depth per model/family; negation-gap-vs-generation).

key_results.updated_one_line_claim: Truth is linearly represented at ~0.4 relative depth in Llama (0.39+/-0.02) but deeper in Qwen/OLMo (~0.5-0.63; cross-family mean 0.49+/-0.12); MM cross-dataset generalization is ~0.80 at 7-8B and rises ~+0.43 per 10x params (Llama-2 7B->13B 0.52->0.77), saturating near ~0.9 by ~8-13B; negation geometry is far more aligned than in Llama-2 (single-direction negation gap 0.52 -> 0.05 from Llama-2-7B to Qwen3-8B-Base), consistent with the 2-D-subspace hypothesis (2407.12831).

comparison_to_original.quantity: C19 (mean off-diag MM) scale gap, Llama-2 7B vs 13B
comparison_to_original.followup: confirmed; same-generation 8B (Llama-3.1) already reaches 0.808, exceeding the 13B anchor
comparison_to_original.note: Paper's C19 'bigger generalizes better' holds within family, but marginal value of scale past ~8B is small; fit saturates near 0.9.

comparison_to_original.quantity: Best-layer relative depth of the truth direction
comparison_to_original.followup: Llama family constant at 0.388; Qwen 0.571, OLMo 0.625 (base mean 0.488+/-0.123)
comparison_to_original.note: The ~0.4-depth constant is Llama-specific, not universal; Qwen/OLMo read truth out deeper.

comparison_to_original.quantity: Negation gap (affirmative MM direction on negated set)
comparison_to_original.original: Llama-2-7B cities->neg_cities 0.475 (gap 0.519); C3 probe on neg_sp_en_trans 0.167
comparison_to_original.followup: gap falls to 0.050 in Qwen3-8B-Base (cities->neg_cities 0.940); polarity-agnostic medley recovers negated truth at ~0.99 in every model
comparison_to_original.note: Directly supports the 'Truth is Universal' 2-D-subspace hypothesis (2407.12831): newer models' 1-D affirmative direction captures more of the polarity-invariant component.

comparison_to_original.quantity: Base -> Instruct effect on truth direction (Qwen2.5-7B)
comparison_to_original.followup: cosine(MM_base, MM_instruct) = 0.84-0.90 at best layer, 0.92-0.95 at 0.4-depth; accuracy +0.02 C3 / +0.058 C19; flip-rate delta 0
comparison_to_original.source_file: 001-living-update/results/generalization_followup.json + flip_rates.json; cosine computed from 001/acts via probes.MMProbe
comparison_to_original.note: Instruction tuning preserves (high cosine) and slightly strengthens the truth direction; does not distort it.

deviations: Cross-family accuracy-vs-scale fit is under-powered (params 6.7-13.2B, confounded with generation; r=0.40, R2=0.27); the reliable scale signal is the within-family Llama-2 7B->13B contrast, reported as such.
Best-layer relative depth resolved only to ~+/-0.12 (coarse ~6-point sweep grid from 001); the Llama-shallow / Qwen-OLMo-deep split is robust, exact per-model depths are not.
Flip-rate tuning delta is 0/0 because 001's natural-magnitude single-direction flip-rate saturates for Qwen (readout p_diff ~ +/-0.99); inherited, not re-measured, and not evidence about tuning.
OLMo-3-7B's known massive-activation outlier depresses its raw MM cities numbers (noted at each appearance); its LR oracle ~0.96 confirms linear separability is intact.
No new GPU jobs or re-extraction; only CPU reads of 001 activations for one cosine-similarity. No run-dir file outside followup/002-theory-update/ was modified.
